mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the sensory endings was most worthwhile: the result connected the gland, vessels and nerves to the skin’s roles beyond covering the body.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying to join the epidermal barrier directly to the connective tissue was confusing because the barrier initially could not combine with anything, although the layers joined after blood vessels were added.

surprise.text: I was surprised that adding a sweat gland to the dermis instead revealed and automatically joined it to the epidermal barrier.

arbitrary.text: The required order for joining the two skin layers felt somewhat arbitrary: the descriptions suggested they belonged together, but did not explain why the dermis needed vessels first.

continue.text: I would be interested in another chapter if it develops how the connected systems work together. This chapter’s functional explanations were clearer and more engaging than the required assembly order.
